text.formatted: The jackal has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
text.plain: The jackal has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

text.formatted: The jackal has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the jackal's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't Incapacitated.
text.plain: The jackal has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the jackal's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't Incapacitated.

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 1 (1d4 - 1) piercing damage.
